2025 is shaping up to be a great year for drone events.

From cornerstone trade shows like Commercial UAV Expo to sensational races like the DRL U.S. Air Force Miami Invitational, there are a bunch of events we’re excited for, both here in the U.S. and around the world.
These events are great venues for finding work and connecting with other drone-minded people.
They’re also the top spots for seeing the newest tech from your favorite drone companies.
Keep reading for all the drone events we’re excited about in 2025, listed in chronological order.
We’ve separated them out into two groups: those based in the U.S. and those based abroad.
